opening: I am writing to apply for the Forward Deployed Engineer role at Freeday. The line in your posting about sitting between the client and the product team, and making sure what gets built actually delivers value in practice, describes the job I have been doing for three years without anyone giving it that title. Digital employees are only useful if they slot into a process someone already has, and that fitting is the hard part.
role_specific: Concretely, the work you describe is the work I have done. At FlowSpace I sat between the internal team, an external agency and the members, translating what people asked for into what we would build, then building it: the support AI agents, the lead capture and enrichment into the CRM, GTM and outbound automations, and a scraping and parsing tool that increased listings while the platform grew from 2,000 to over 4,500 active users. I built integrations against Office RnD and Nexudus for automated bookings, plus Clubee, Sendgrid, Google APIs and both OpenAI and Anthropic. For UltraStrategy I built an AI data parsing tool in n8n and Eden AI; for Get2Germany, automated workflows. Prototyping fast and explaining it plainly is most of what I do, and I lean on n8n, TypeScript, Next.js and Python depending on what the problem needs.
closing: Two things stated up front. My degree is a BA in Philosophy, International Studies and Economics from Ca' Foscari rather than Computer Science, AI or Econometrics; I have no CS degree and I would rather you know now. And I am currently based in Venice, not the Netherlands, so this would be a relocation. My Italian EU long-term residence permit means that needs no sponsorship from you. I would be glad to talk through the integrations in detail.
